move: badge pops in, laurels draw, confetti bursts, upvote counter runs up
how: On a pale peach stage a pill badge with a round P mark and the text #1 Product of the Week bounces in from scale 0.2 and -12deg rotation with back.out(2.2) over the first 25%; the P spins in from -180deg. Two laurel branches are drawn as SVG stems via drawSVG over 30% and their leaves scale in from the stem with back.out(3) at 35ms stagger. A black vote chip and a product name slide up (expo.out) at 20-25%; the vote number counts 0 to 1,284 (power3.out, 47%) while the triangle bobs six times. Forty-six confetti rectangles fire ballistically from centre (positions computed from velocity and gravity in an onUpdate) between 10% and 63%, fading out at the end of their flight. The badge wiggles +/-2deg at 63%, then the whole composition scales to 0.85 and fades with expo.in at 88%.
adapt: Change the rank text, product name and tagline, the upvote target, the brand red (#ff6154) and confetti colours; leaf count and laurel radius are parameters. Keep the 0.7s back.out pop, the counter length and the confetti window.
port: mount(el, shot) creates the SVG laurel (branch() builds paths), badge, votes, name and the confetti divs inside el, seeded with fx.rng-style deterministic randomness. animate(el, shot, D) returns the same timeline with the counter tween and the ballistic confetti proxy tween (onUpdate gsap.set) placed at the same fractions of D; the querySelector for .num must be scoped to el. DrawSVGPlugin must be registered.
caveats: confetti uses a proxy tween with onUpdate calling gsap.set on 46 elements
exits to blank rather than returning to the first frame; the loop restarts from the pop
